evidence.AC1: POST /todos with {"title":"past","dueDate":"2020-01-01"} returned 201 with dueDate "2020-01-01". A POST without dueDate returned 201 with dueDate null. The date is a plain YYYY-MM-DD string with no time part.
evidence.AC2: PATCH /todos/4 with {"dueDate":"2021-05-05"} returned 200 and the todo now had dueDate 2021-05-05. PATCH with {"dueDate":null} returned 200 and dueDate was null again.
evidence.AC3: POST with dueDate "2026-02-30" returned 400. POST with "01.02.2026" returned 400. POST with "2026-02-30T10:00:00Z" returned 400. PATCH with "2021-02-30" returned 400.
evidence.AC4: Today in UTC is 2026-11-01. I created todos with due dates 2020-01-01 (not done), 2099-01-01, 2026-11-01 (today), none, and 2020-01-01 (later marked done via PATCH). GET /todos?overdue=true returned only the 2020-01-01 not-done todo. GET /todos?overdue=false returned the future, today, no-date and done-past todos. The done todo showed overdue:false after PATCH done:true.
evidence.AC5: The list page at / showed 'fällig: 2020-01-01', 'fällig: 2099-01-01', 'fällig: 2026-11-01' and 'fällig: 2020-01-01' next to the todos that have a due date. The todo without a due date showed no due text.
evidence.AC6: On the list page only the 'past' todo (due 2020-01-01, not done) carried 'überfällig'. The future, today, no-date and done-past todos did not.
evidence.AC7: The page has a checkbox labelled 'nur überfällige'. Checking it reduced the list to the single 'past' todo marked überfällig. The only console error was a missing favicon 404.
